tools.name: assign_bin_owner
tools.description: Assigns a staff member as the responsible owner of a storage bin and records the change time on the bin record. The new owner gains permission to adjust stock counts in that bin.

params.name: new_owner_id
params.description: ID of the employee becoming the bin owner

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Optional

from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = os.environ.get("WAREHOUSE_DB", "warehouse.db")


@dataclass
class BinOwnerResult:
    success: bool
    bin_id: str
    owner_id: Optional[str] = None
    previous_owner_id: Optional[str] = None
    updated_at: Optional[str] = None


@tool
def assign_bin_owner(bin_id: str, new_owner_id: str) -> BinOwnerResult:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        row = conn.execute("SELECT owner_id FROM bins WHERE id = ?", (bin_id,)).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return BinOwnerResult(False, bin_id)

        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
        conn.execute("UPDATE bins SET owner_id = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?", (new_owner_id, now, bin_id))
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO bin_permissions (bin_id, employee_id, can_adjust_stock) VALUES (?, ?, 1)",
            (bin_id, new_owner_id),
        )
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()

    return BinOwnerResult(True, bin_id, new_owner_id, row[0], now)
